description:
Generate a set of variations of one sound, free: the same sound played differently each time, so a game or a video never repeats one file (a cartoon character's footsteps, sword swings, punches, impacts, grunts, gunshots, UI clicks). Each variation is its own WAV, lined up with the original's attack and matched to its length, tone and loudness: lay them along a video timeline, or put them in a game's random container (Godot AudioStreamRandomizer, FMOD or Wwise, Unity) next to the original.
The simplest call is just sound_id: the id (or slug) of a sound from search_sounds, get_sound or download_sound. To vary a sound you made with generate_sound, send take_id instead: the id of one of its takes. One-shots up to 10 seconds; not ambiences.
Optional: spread, how different the variations are: "subtle" (2: same recording, a little alive; UI clicks, coins, gunshots), "natural" (5, the default: the same thing done again; footsteps, impacts, swings) or "bold" (8: a different performance; one grunt per character), or 1 to 10. takes: how many, 1 to 8, default 6.
Waits for them (usually 5–10 seconds, up to about 30 for a long sound) and returns takes, each with a url (WAV), preview_url (MP3), file_name (<sound>-var-01.wav, -var-02.wav…) and a ready curl command: save them all. If the status is still "running", call get_generation with the id. Links work for 120 days. Each variation counts as one generation (250 a week per account, one job at a time), so ask for the number you'll use. They're AI-generated (ai_content "ai"); tell the person.

prompt.description: What the sound is, if its title doesn't say. Usually leave out.

seed.description: Any whole number. Send the same seed with the same sound and settings to get the same variations back; leave it out to get new ones each time.

sound_id.description: The sound to vary: the id (or slug) that search_sounds, get_sound and download_sound return for it. Send this or take_id.

spread.description: How different the variations are: "subtle" (2), "natural" (5), "bold" (8), or 1 to 10. Default "natural" (5).

take_id.description: To vary a sound you made with generate_sound: the id of one of its takes. Send this or sound_id.

takes.description: How many variations, best first: 1 to 8. Default 6. Each one counts as a generation.

name: vary_sound
title: Generate sound variations
